subject: VenturePay POC — recommended engine shortlist and runway plan
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 18:02:00 -0700
Subject: VenturePay POC — quick recap and recommended engines

Hi Alex / Jordan —

Thanks again for a really productive demo this morning. Quick recap from our side and a suggested path forward so procurement and engineering have a clean set of asks.

What we heard:
- Primary goal: fast, reliable conversational search in customer support flows (95th pctile latency target ~150ms for short queries).
- Cost sensitivity: target hosted unit cost that scales predictably (Goal: <= $0.003/token average for the bulk retail workload).
- Quality constraints: low hallucination for financial guidance prompts; regression tolerance is very low for correctness-critical responses.

Attached are the benchmark snapshots and our initial prompt set (prompt_set_v1.jsonl). High-level recommended shortlist for the POC:
1) Redwood-Executor-2 (quantized) — best cost/latency for high throughput; slightly lower long-form factuality than the heavyweight family.
2) Redwood-Sentinel-Large — strong accuracy on instruction-following; higher token cost and 20–30% higher p50 latency.
3) Redwood-Hybrid-td (mixed precision) — good mid-point, useful if you need the safety/QA headroom without full cost of Sentinel.

Next steps we suggest this week:
- VenturePay engineering: pick 1 primary engine (we recommend Executor-2) and 1 fallback (Sentinel-Large) so we can run A/B sims.
- Procurement: share vendor onboarding timeline + any required data processing agreements (we can prioritize SOC2 evidence).
- Redwood: provide a short-run evaluation bundle (14 days) and a guardrail test pack for regression monitoring.

If that sounds right, I can loop in our contracts and infra lead and schedule a 30-minute alignment tomorrow.

Thanks —
Jonas

On Thu, Jul 29, 2027 at 6:02 PM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> Attached are the benchmark snapshots and our initial prompt set (prompt_set_v1.jsonl). High-level recommended shortlist for the POC:
> 1) Redwood-Executor-2 (quantized) — best cost/latency for high throughput; slightly lower long-form factuality than the heavyweight family.

Alex — following up with the attachments (links + small CSV snapshot). Summary notes from the benchmarks we ran against VenturePay sample traces: 
- Executor-2 (Q4) — p50 95ms, p95 190ms (on m60g instances, continuous batching). Token cost estimate: ~$0.0026/token for the mix in your sample (30M token-month -> ~$78k).
- Sentinel-Large — p50 140ms, p95 260ms. Token cost estimate: ~$0.0052/token.
- Hybrid-td — p50 115ms, p95 210ms. Token cost estimate: ~$0.0036/token.

Notes on quality/regression risk:
- Executor-2 shows occasional lower factuality on long multi-step finance prompts; we flagged 8/120 failing cases in your set. Those tend to be where the model hallucinates a numeric interest rate or cites non-existent policy references.
- Sentinel-Large passed 116/120; best for correctness-critical snippets.

Recommended evaluation run plan (what Redwood will deliver):
- 14-day sandbox with sandbox-key and preloaded prompt set V1 + your 120-case baseline.
- Two A/B lanes: Executor-2 primary, Sentinel fallback. We'll collect p50/p95, token counts, and a hallucination score per prompt.
- Regression alerting: we will wire a weekly quality report and will create a blocking alert if hallucination error rate > 3% on the baseline.

Attachments included: vpay_benchmarks_0727.csv, prompt_set_v1.jsonl, redwood_sla_summary.pdf.

Action items for Redwood (assigned):
- Finalize sandbox and share creds (Jonas).
- Prepare cost simulation for scaled runs (Ben).
- Provide SOC2 evidence link and sub-processor list (Marissa).

Marissa

Quick numbers for procurement modeling (30M token-month baseline):

- Hybrid-td: ~$108,000 / month (approx $0.0036/token).
- Sentinel-Large: ~$156,000 / month (approx $0.0052/token).

We will provision a 14-day sandbox by EOD today. Sandbox key: REDWOOD-SBX-VP-20270730 (will be rotated after the window). Access instructions and an ops-runbook (short) will be in the Drive folder listed below.

If VenturePay confirms Executor-2 as the primary engine, we'll provide a custom guardrail pack for the 8 failing cases we flagged (prompt-level mitigations + recommended reranking). If you'd rather run Sentinel-Large as primary, we can swap lanes and show the delta in cost and p95 latency in the first 72 hours.

Next internal: I'll prepare a short one-pager cost/latency delta for the two-path approach (Executor primary / Sentinel fallback) and share with procurement. Jonas — can you schedule the 30-min alignment with Alex for tomorrow 10:00 PT?

Thanks —
